% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): legend images: only marks, area
% legend, \addlegendimage with empty legend and a custom style, legend image
% post style.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[legend pos=north west, legend image post style={semithick}]
\addplot+[only marks] coordinates {(0,1) (1,2) (2,1.5)};
\addlegendentry{measured}
\addplot+[area legend, fill=red!20] coordinates {(0,0) (1,1) (2,0.5)};
\addlegendentry{area}
\addlegendimage{empty legend}
\addlegendentry{--- model ---}
\addlegendimage{black, dashed, mark=triangle*}
\addlegendentry{custom}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
